scenarios.requirement: Reuse exactly four business accounts (two inspectors and two supervisors) for functional collaboration, permissions and multi-tab isolation; formal load testing and performance SLO acceptance are deferred.
Display usable models and personal quota; request, supervisor approval, token reservation/deduction, preexisting-access fallback and denied cross-user changes.

Run the actual candidate Python PTH worker over owned Kafka/OSS test input; verify candidate image, DB receipt persistence, restart/no duplicate inference, unauthorized owner and unknown-result fence.
Use the actual candidate app/SDK with scripted model responses; persist/restore conversation, workbench parent/child/tool provenance, model snapshot and cancellation fence.
Install/use a private MCP under an owned supervisor; verify fetch, cancellation, writer-tree exit, journal-pool identity, image retention and uncertain write reconciliation.
Create SDK-origin draft; owner edits, supervisor review, export, outbox delivery and unauthorized retries preserve version/audit linkage.
Capture an authorized persisted run, draft/evaluate/review/publish/load a skill, then rollback/archive without exposing private source.
Use owned memory storage and scripted or infer=false extraction; verify owner isolation, lifecycle review, retention and governed model-key restoration with no paid model call.
Boot candidate backend/web/worker against an owned migrated 29-table clone; verify health and persisted data, same-schema application recovery and failure-maintenance boundary.
